findings.title: Full FIFO same-address dual-port read/write ambiguity
findings.original_issue: Full-ring push was allowed when read_en despite wp==rp, requiring mapped BRAM cross-port old-data behavior not proved by RTL simulation.
findings.resolution: Final s_ready requires count<FIFO_DEPTH even on read cycles. At full occupancy the host is backpressured, and no write is accepted. RAM read continues independently, freeing space for a later input. For partial nonempty occupancy ring pointers differ; empty FIFO cannot read. Therefore legal simultaneous read/write cannot use equal addresses.
findings.verification: Main and protocol testbenches assert no push&&read_en&&wp==rp. Directed depth3 test fills three RAM slots plus pixel holding register, verifies ready0/push0 while full, then drains/refills with exact fixed sensor tick sequence and data oracle. Entire main/numeric/protocol/synthesis reports PASS on final RTL.

Leading HBLANK and initial/trailing vertical blank permit existing DVP RX lock and final line/frame validation
Global synchronous reset works CE0; fixed-cadence error handling otherwise waits safe boundary
Configuration capture and legal blank/period/geometry counter limits covered
